ideas.pitch: An interactive web debugger that steps through array sliding window algorithms visually, identifying off-by-one errors and time complexity bottlenecks in real-time.
ideas.title: SlidingWindow Visualizer & Debugger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core topics of Section A (Arrays, Sliding Window, Monotonic Stack) by providing educational tooling for other programmers.

ideas.pitch: A specialized browser IDE designed specifically for practicing and visualizing monotonic stack problems with instant memory and time complexity profiling.
ideas.title: Monotonic Stack Playground
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on the advanced algorithmic data structures highlighted in the Technical Team Online Assessment requirements.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight web-based frontend and parser that visualizes raw C++ pointer references, object lifetime, and virtual method tables for OOP polymorphism debugging.
ideas.title: C++ Memory Leak & Pointer Inspector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals directly to the C++ core concepts (Pointers, References, OOP, Polymorphism, STL) evaluated in Section C of the assessment.

ideas.pitch: An interactive diagnostic sandbox for testing HTTP request headers, preflight requests, and cross-origin resource sharing policies with live error explanations.
ideas.title: CORS & REST API Sandbox
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the specific Web Development topics (HTTP, REST APIs, CORS) covered in Section B of the evaluation format.

ideas.pitch: A performance analysis dashboard that compares C++ Standard Template Library container operations against custom sliding window implementations.
ideas.title: STL Algorithm Complexity Benchmarker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines high-performance C++ concepts with algorithmic benchmarking, satisfying the rigorous problem-solving focus of the technical team assessment.
